Container.Name: Downsizarr
Container.Overview:
Downsizarr batch-transcodes your H264 video library to H265/HEVC to reclaim disk space while preserving quality. GPU-first by default (NVIDIA NVENC / CUDA), with CPU libx265 and Intel QSV/VAAPI also selectable per run. Browse your shares from a web GUI, queue small QA batches first, then scale up. Shows per-file encode time/speed and a queue ETA. Originals are never modified - converted files are written next to the source with a .hevc suffix. Tracks per-file sizes and total space saved over time.
NVIDIA GPU: requires the Unraid "Nvidia Driver" plugin. This template adds --runtime=nvidia; set NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES to your GPU UUID (from the Nvidia Driver plugin page) or leave it as "all".

Config.Name: Media Share
Config.Description: Your media share. Read/write required - converted files are written next to the source.

Config.Name: Config / DB
Config.Description: Stores the metrics database and logs.

Config.Name: Default Encoder
Config.Description: hevc_nvenc (NVIDIA GPU/CUDA, default), libx265 (CPU, best quality), hevc_qsv or hevc_vaapi (Intel/AMD GPU).

Config.Name: Default CRF / CQ
Config.Description: Quality target. Lower = higher quality + larger. 18 is high quality.

Config.Name: Default Preset
Config.Description: NVENC: p1 (fastest) .. p7 (best quality, default). libx265: ultrafast..veryslow (e.g. slow).

Config.Name: NVENC full CUDA decode
Config.Description: Decode AND encode on the GPU (fastest). Set false to decode on CPU (more compatible with unusual sources).

Config.Name: NVIDIA GPU
Config.Description: GPU UUID from the Unraid Nvidia Driver plugin (e.g. GPU-abc123...), or 'all'. Required for NVENC.

Config.Name: Max Concurrent
Config.Description: How many transcodes run at once. 1 is fine for GPU; keep at 1 for CPU/libx265.

Config.Name: Output Suffix
Config.Description: Inserted before the extension: Movie.mkv -> Movie.hevc.mkv

Config.Name: Intel GPU (QSV/VAAPI)
Config.Description: Optional: pass through an Intel iGPU for hevc_qsv / hevc_vaapi (not needed for NVIDIA).
